description: This file contains utility functions for managing color schemes, label colors, and color maps within the Superset frontend, including functions for resetting, updating, and applying color schemes and label colors.

methods.name: getColorNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace or undefined if falsy, defaulting to global namespace.

methods.name: enforceSharedLabelsColorsArray
methods.description: Ensures shared label colors are returned as an array, converting from object if necessary.

methods.name: getFreshSharedLabels
methods.description: Merges current shared labels with labels that are shared across all charts, removing duplicates.

methods.name: getSharedLabelsColorMapEntries
methods.description: Filters the current color map to include only shared labels.

methods.name: getFreshLabelsColorMapEntries
methods.description: Returns all label-color entries except custom label colors.

methods.name: getDynamicLabelsColors
methods.description: Returns label-color entries excluding custom label colors.

methods.name: getColorSchemeDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the color array for a given color scheme from the registry.

methods.name: isLabelsColorMapSynced
methods.description: Checks if the current labels color map is synchronized with a fresh one, ignoring custom label colors.

methods.name: resetColors
methods.description: Resets all color maps and namespaces to default.

methods.name: refreshLabelsColorMap
methods.description: Updates the labels color map based on the current color scheme, optionally merging.

methods.name: applyColors
methods.description: Applies label colors to the namespace, with options for fresh, merge, and shared labels.
